result.description: The Quillray Auris is a fictional pocket-sized portable storage drive designed for field notes, travel backups, and lightweight media transfer. It uses a USB-C interface and a compact solid-state design to keep files accessible without the bulk of a desktop drive. With a 512GB capacity, it is positioned as a midrange personal archive device rather than an enterprise component, and its fictionalized casing emphasizes quiet operation, scratch resistance, and easy carry use.
result.title: Quillray Auris 512GB USB-C Pocket Archive Drive
